_about.what_this_is: The rules that make a registry model_sheet line checkable by a vision model: words that describe a mood instead of something visible, the longest line allowed, and the picture file types an anchor may be.
_about.why_it_exists: A judge model can answer 'is the hair short red coils?' from a picture. It cannot answer 'is the face confident?'. A line it cannot answer is a line nobody checks, so the gate refuses it.
_about.how_to_use_it: scripts/lib.mjs (checkModelSheet) reads this file when it checks a registry. A line that holds one of non_visual_words fails with the word named; rewrite the line as what the eye sees (the mouth corner lifted, the brows drawn together) or drop the word.
_about.next_step: Found a mood word the gate let through? Add it to non_visual_words and run npm run verify.
